The vehicles and tools used in connection with unlicensed or unregistered activity at any work site shall be subject to seizure and forfeiture.
(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022; Am. L.L. 2025/142, 10/25/2025, eff. 2/22/2026)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2008/008 and L.L. 2021/126.
